name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
about: An AICTE scheme to support girls studying technical education. 2,000 scholarships a year go to degree students (and 2,000 to diploma students), chosen on merit.
benefits: ₹30,000 a year towards tuition fees, or towards books, equipment, software, a laptop or desktop, a vehicle or competitive exam fees
₹2,000 a month for 10 months a year as incidental charges
eligibilityText: Girl students admitted to the first year of a degree course in an AICTE-approved institution through the state or central centralised admission process
Family income up to ₹8 lakh a year in the previous financial year (for married girls, the higher of parents' or in-laws' income)
Up to two girl children per family
Selection on merit from the qualifying examination; 15% of awards reserved for SC, 7.5% for ST and 27% for OBC

rules.label: First year of the degree course
Technical course in an AICTE-approved institution
Family income up to ₹8 lakh a year
